description.value: Grizzly Helicopters is a family-owned operator that has been flying out of Campbell River and Port McNeill since 2008, offering glacier tours, heli-fishing fly-ins, and commercial charters across north-central Vancouver Island and the BC coast. Touring cyclists looking to add an aerial dimension to their trip can join a scenic glacier landing tour or a catch-and-release heli-fishing adventure in otherwise inaccessible wilderness rivers. The fleet of Astar 350 helicopters carries up to five passengers with panoramic visibility from all seats.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Grizzly Helicopters is an active family-owned helicopter charter and tour operator with two BC locations. The OSM coordinates (50.5889, -127.0903) place this node at Port McNeill, and the OSM phone number (+1-250-956-4600) matches the Port McNeill number listed on the website's contact page, confirming this is the Port McNeill location. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address populated from website contact page based on matching OSM coordinates to the Port McNeill hangar location (1488 Beach Drive).

Business operates from two locations (Campbell River and Port McNeill); the OSM node and phone number correspond to the Port McNeill base only — a separate OSM record may exist or be needed for the Campbell River base at 4000 Midport Rd.
Website copyright reads 2017, suggesting the site has not been recently updated, though content appears current and business is confirmed active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Grizzly Helicopters offers scenic tours that could appeal to cyclists seeking an add-on adventure, but no cycling-friendly infrastructure is documented anywhere on the website, and the business is primarily a commercial/medevac helicopter operator rather than a ground-level attraction designed to serve visiting cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists heli-tours accommodating up to 5 guests and heli-fishing for up to 4 guests, both with local pilot-guides. Picnic options are mentioned for glacier tours. These experiential details may be relevant if the listing is included.

judgement.verdict_reason: Established bookable tour operator, like other included operators.

wow_evidence: Family heli operator since 2008; glacier-landing tours are day-shaping if taken. Local operator, no independent story beyond that.
blurb: Helicopter glacier-landing tours and charters from Port McNeill and Campbell River.

price.label: Premium
price.signal: Helicopter tours, no prices listed; advance-booking high-cost service type
